## Objective
- Build a complete, playable space mission game where players choose a planet and rocket, then control the mission.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Verify visually with small JPEG screenshots at viewport width no greater than 1280px, reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html` without a framework.
- Mission flow includes preflight, launch, navigation alignment, and landing, with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive setup screen with four destinations and three spacecraft choices.
- Added canvas flight scenes, telemetry, controls, sound toggle, and mission results.
- Fixed the preview console error; the browser console now reports zero errors and warnings.
- Played through preflight, launch, cruise alignment, and landing in browser testing; captured and read `screenshots/starward-flight.jpg`.

### Active
- Tune landing controls and confirm a successful touchdown and failure outcome.
- Verify mobile layout and capture a final gameplay screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue the landing test and adjust controls or physics if needed to make safe touchdown reliably playable.
2. Test failure and retry/home flows, then check mobile layout and console.
3. Save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/starward-flight.jpg`: latest gameplay visual check.
- `screenshots/starward-setup.jpg`: setup-screen visual check.

## Important Context
- Preview runs at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The current browser test reached landing with throttle at 100%, altitude around 63 km, and speed around 1.6 km/s; touchdown is not yet verified.
- A negative mission clock observed during testing was corrected by clamping frame delta and resetting the timer.
